mapper.select: SELECT -- 当日统计 COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS today_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN salary ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_revenue, -- 当月统计 COUNT(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 END) AS month_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN salary ELSE 0 END), 0) AS month_revenue, -- 累计统计 COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0) AS total_revenue, -- 平均值 COALESCE(AVG(salary), 0) AS avg_salary, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN salary END), 0) AS today_avg_salary, -- 日期信息 CURDATE() AS stat_date, DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start_date FROM custom_contract;

-- 获取用户维度统计数据（实时计算） SELECT -- 活跃用户数（最近30天有交易的用户） COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN username END) AS active_users, -- 新增用户数（今日首次交易的用户） COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN username END) AS new_users, -- VIP用户数（累计交易金额 > 10000 的用户） COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_amount > 10000 THEN username END) AS vip_users FROM ( SELECT username, create_time, SUM(1) OVER (PARTITION BY username) as total_amount FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0 ) t;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS keyName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN username END) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS new_users FROM system_users WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY keyName;

select c.status AS code, d.label AS status_name, d.value, t.type, t.name, COUNT(*) AS count, sum(salary) as salary FROM custom_contract c LEFT JOIN system_dict_data d ON d.value = c.status LEFT JOIN system_dict_type t ON t.type = d.dict_type WHERE t.type = 'contract_status' GROUP BY c.status, d.label, d.value, t.type, t.name ORDER BY c.status
